title: 'The Murders in the Rue Morgue,' by Edgar Allen Poe, Part Two (3/3)
titleZh: 愛倫坡〈莫爾格街兇殺案〉第二部 (3/3)
summaryZh: 愛倫坡故事中，眾人發現母女兩具屍體，隔天報紙刊出目擊者的說法。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — American Stories

sentences.text: A lockbox was found left open, with just a few old letters and papers inside.
sentences.zh: 有一個保險箱被打開放在那裡，裡面只剩幾封舊信和文件。

sentences.text: But when the group inspected the fireplace, they discovered another horror.
sentences.zh: 但眾人檢查壁爐的時候，又發現了另一件恐怖的事。

sentences.text: A still warm body had been forced up the chimney.
sentences.zh: 一具還帶著餘溫的屍體，被硬塞進了煙囪裡。

sentences.text: It was the old woman's daughter.
There was blood on the face, and dark, deep finger marks on the neck, suggesting a strangling.
sentences.zh: 她臉上有血，脖子上有又深又黑的指痕，看起來是被勒死的。

sentences.text: After searching the house, the group went outside.
sentences.zh: 搜完屋子之後，眾人走到外面。

sentences.text: They found the body of the old woman behind the building.
sentences.zh: 他們在建築物後面找到了老婦人的屍體。

sentences.text: Her neck had been cut so severely, that when they tried to lift the body, the head fell off.
sentences.zh: 她的脖子被割得太深，眾人想抬起屍體的時候，頭就掉了下來。

sentences.text: The next day, the newspaper offered to its readers these new facts.
sentences.zh: 隔天，報紙向讀者披露了這些新的細節。

sentences.text: The police have questioned many people about the vicious murders in the old house on the rue morgue.
sentences.zh: 警方針對莫爾格街那棟老屋裡的兇殘命案，已經訊問了許多人。

sentences.text: Pauline Dubourg, a wash woman, said she has known both of the victims for more than three years,
sentences.zh: 洗衣婦 Pauline Dubourg 說，她認識這兩位死者已經三年多，

sentences.text: She said, "The two seemed to love each other dearly.
sentences.zh: 她說：「這兩個人看起來感情非常好。
她們給她的工錢也一向很優厚。
